name: Martial Mayhem Mutagen (Greater)

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Your senses sharpen and your mind floods with tactical opportunities, overwhelming your foes—though the rush of possibilities can overwhelm you instead.

The duration is 1 hour.

Benefit You gain a +3 item bonus to skill checks to disarm, grapple, reposition, shove, and trip, and your melee Strikes deal 1d6 additional precision damage to Off-Guard creatures. When you succeed at a melee attack roll, the target is off-guard to your next attack roll against it before the start of your next turn.

Drawback You take a –2 penalty to Will saves, Intelligence-based skill checks, and skill checks to sense-motive. When you fail at a melee attack roll, you are Clumsy 1 until the end of your next turn.

Effect: Martial Mayhem Mutagen (Greater)
